_file_header.purpose: Anlami net ve encoding sorunu olmayan pet konusmalarini exact-source overlay ile ASCII Turkceye cevirir
_file_header.description: pettalktable.xml icindeki 1787 guvenli benzersiz ifadeyi 2843 exact kaynak satirinda Turkcelestirir; bozuk kaynaklar recovery havuzunda kalir

5.source_en: <feeding>	Not bad, what else ya got?	</feeding>

6.source_en: <feeding>	Um, is that it, I was hoping for more...	</feeding>
6.translation_tr: <feeding>	Hmm, bu kadar mi? Daha fazlasini umuyordum...	</feeding>

7.source_en: <feeding>	That was tasty, got any more?	</feeding>

8.source_en: <feeding>	Can I have some more please?	</feeding>

9.source_en: <feeding>	Ooh! More please! I liked that very much.	</feeding>
9.translation_tr: <feeding>	Ooh! Biraz daha lutfen! Bunu cok begendim.	</feeding>

10.source_en: <hunting>	Do I get to have the eatable things we find?	</hunting>
10.translation_tr: <hunting>	Buldugumuz yenilebilir seyler bana mi kalacak?	</hunting>

11.source_en: <hunting>	Ooh, can I eat the next thing that drops?	</hunting>
11.translation_tr: <hunting>	Ooh, siradaki dusen seyi yiyebilir miyim?	</hunting>

12.source_en: <hunting>	I'm eat all the jellopies for myself!	</hunting>

13.source_en: <hunting>	Oh my gosh, I hope you don't kill anyone I know.	</hunting>
13.translation_tr: <hunting>	Aman tanrim, umarim tanidigim kimseyi oldurmezsin.	</hunting>

14.source_en: <danger>	If you die, what do you drop?	</danger>

15.source_en: <danger>	I'll be alright for a bit, feed yourself and heal up!	</danger>
15.translation_tr: <danger>	Bir sure idare ederim, once kendini besle ve iyiles!	</danger>

16.source_en: <danger>	I think you need the food more then I do...	</danger>
16.translation_tr: <danger>	Sanirim yemege benden daha cok ihtiyacin var...	</danger>

17.source_en: <danger>	I was saving this apple for later, but you look like you need it more.	</danger>
17.translation_tr: <danger>	Bu elmayi sonraya sakliyordum ama senin daha cok ihtiyacin var gibi.	</danger>

18.source_en: <danger>	If I heal you, will you feed me after?	</danger>
18.translation_tr: <danger>	Seni iyilestirirsem sonra beni besler misin?	</danger>

19.source_en: <danger>	I think you should heal yourself, you don't look too good.	</danger>
19.translation_tr: <danger>	Bence kendini iyilestirmelisin, pek iyi gorunmuyorsun.	</danger>

20.source_en: <dead>	Don't blame me, I'm a poring! Like I'd have stood a better chance.	</dead>
20.translation_tr: <dead>	Beni suclama, ben bir Poring'im! Sanki daha iyi sansim varmis gibi.	</dead>

21.source_en: <dead>	Hey um, does this mean no more food?	</dead>
21.translation_tr: <dead>	Hey, yani artik yemek yok mu?	</dead>

22.source_en: <dead>	...*poke*... *poke*... ... ... ... *poke* ... aw man... now who's gonna feed me?	</dead>
22.translation_tr: <dead>	...*durter*... *durter*... ... ... ... *durter* ... ah be... simdi beni kim besleyecek?	</dead>

23.source_en: <dead>	Hey, get up, this isn't the best place to nap... *poke*... um, you ok?	</dead>
23.translation_tr: <dead>	Hey, kalk, burasi uyumak icin iyi bir yer degil... *durter*... iyi misin?	</dead>

24.source_en: <dead>	Hey, why aren't you moving anymore? Get up!	</dead>
24.translation_tr: <dead>	Hey, neden artik hareket etmiyorsun? Kalk!	</dead>

25.source_en: <stand>	Hey um, before we go, can you feed me?	</stand>
25.translation_tr: <stand>	Hey, gitmeden once beni besler misin?	</stand>

26.source_en: <stand>	I don't want to be annoying, but... I'm a little hungry...	</stand>
26.translation_tr: <stand>	Rahatsiz etmek istemem ama... biraz acim...	</stand>

27.source_en: <stand>	You know, I haven't been fed for a while...	</stand>

28.source_en: <stand>	Hey, where are we going, is there food there?	</stand>
28.translation_tr: <stand>	Hey, nereye gidiyoruz, orada yemek var mi?	</stand>

29.source_en: <stand>	If you use me as a chair, will you feed me?	</stand>
29.translation_tr: <stand>	Beni sandalye gibi kullanirsan beni besler misin?	</stand>

30.source_en: <stand>	All the other pets are eating now...	</stand>
30.translation_tr: <stand>	Diger tum petler simdi yemek yiyor...	</stand>

32.source_en: <stand>	Wait, what about me? I'm still hungry!	</stand>

33.source_en: <connect>	Hey! Welcome back, did you break me something to eat?	</connect>
33.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey! Hos geldin, bana yiyecek bir sey getirdin mi?	</connect>

34.source_en: <connect>	Hey there you are, I've been starving!	</connect>

35.source_en: <connect>	Oh, you're back, yay, now I can get fed. ^^	</connect>
35.translation_tr: <connect>	Ah, geri geldin, yasasin, simdi yemek yiyebilirim. ^^	</connect>

36.source_en: <connect>	Ooh Ooh, do I smell something, did you bring me food?	</connect>
36.translation_tr: <connect>	Ooh Ooh, bir koku mu aliyorum, bana yemek mi getirdin?	</connect>

38.source_en: <connect>	Welcome back! Now feed me! You haven't fed me for... oh no, I've forgotten it's been so long!	</connect>
38.translation_tr: <connect>	Hos geldin! Simdi beni besle! Beni beslemeyeli... aman, o kadar uzun oldu ki unuttum!	</connect>

39.source_en: <levelup>	Awesome, good job, do I get a treat?	</levelup>
39.translation_tr: <levelup>	Harika, iyi is, odul olarak yiyecek var mi?	</levelup>

41.source_en: <levelup>	Sweet!... hmm, speaking of which, where's the food?	</levelup>
41.translation_tr: <levelup>	Harika!... hmm, yemek demisken, yemek nerede?	</levelup>

42.source_en: <levelup>	Hey, when do I get to fight and level too?	</levelup>
42.translation_tr: <levelup>	Hey, ben ne zaman savasip level atlayacagim?	</levelup>

43.source_en: <levelup>	Okay, you got your level, do I get to eat now?	</levelup>
43.translation_tr: <levelup>	Tamam, level atladin, simdi yemek yiyebilir miyim?	</levelup>

47.source_en: <feeding>	Yum~ that was good... more please!	</feeding>

48.source_en: <feeding>	Yuck, don't you check these things before you buy them? That was awful.	</feeding>
48.translation_tr: <feeding>	Iyy, bunlari almadan once kontrol etmiyor musun? Berbatti.	</feeding>

49.source_en: <feeding>	Mmm, that was pretty good, almost got me full.	</feeding>

51.source_en: <hunting>	Are you sure the monsters here drop eatable things?	</hunting>
51.translation_tr: <hunting>	Buradaki canavarlarin yenilebilir seyler dusurdugune emin misin?	</hunting>

52.source_en: <hunting>	Can I go scrounging for food... just a snack...	</hunting>
52.translation_tr: <hunting>	Yemek aramaya gidebilir miyim... sadece atistirmalik...	</hunting>

53.source_en: <hunting>	Hey, if I distract it, can I get some food later on?	</hunting>
53.translation_tr: <hunting>	Hey, onun dikkatini dagitirsam sonra biraz yemek alabilir miyim?	</hunting>

54.source_en: <hunting>	Hey, if a poring gets what drops, you're not really gonna kill it... are you?	</hunting>
54.translation_tr: <hunting>	Hey, dusen esyayi bir Poring alirsa onu gercekten oldurmeyeceksin... degil mi?	</hunting>

55.source_en: <danger>	Don't you dare die on me... I haven't been fed yet!	</danger>
55.translation_tr: <danger>	Sakin bana olup gitme... daha yemek yemedim!	</danger>

56.source_en: <danger>	Hey, heal up silly, I'm not gonna do it.	</danger>
56.translation_tr: <danger>	Hey, kendini iyilestir sersem, ben yapmayacagim.	</danger>

57.source_en: <danger>	If you die, can I search you for food?	</danger>

58.source_en: <danger>	If you die, does that mean the loot is mine to eat?	</danger>

59.source_en: <danger>	Please don't get killed, I don't know where to get food around here.	</danger>
59.translation_tr: <danger>	Lutfen olme, buralarda nereden yemek bulacagimi bilmiyorum.	</danger>

60.source_en: <dead>	Wow, you died... so now what?	</dead>

61.source_en: <dead>	Now why'd you go and do that? Now what am I gonna eat?	</dead>
61.translation_tr: <dead>	Neden gidip bunu yaptin? Simdi ben ne yiyecegim?	</dead>

63.source_en: <dead>	I see dead people...or... well you at least.	</dead>
63.translation_tr: <dead>	Olu insanlar goruyorum... ya da... en azindan seni.	</dead>

64.source_en: <dead>	NOO you forgot to feed me, now what will I do!?	</dead>
64.translation_tr: <dead>	HAYIR, beni beslemeyi unuttun, simdi ne yapacagim!?	</dead>

65.source_en: <stand>	I really like traveling with you, especially when we eat. ^^	</stand>
65.translation_tr: <stand>	Seninle gezmeyi cok seviyorum, ozellikle yemek yerken. ^^	</stand>

66.source_en: <stand>	I think we should go find some more food, what do you think?	</stand>
66.translation_tr: <stand>	Bence biraz daha yemek bulmaliyiz, ne dersin?	</stand>

68.source_en: <stand>	Sit a little longer with me? I still need more time to rest.	</stand>
68.translation_tr: <stand>	Benimle biraz daha oturur musun? Biraz daha dinlenmem gerekiyor.	</stand>

69.source_en: <stand>	Hey, can we go lookin' for jellopies now?	</stand>
69.translation_tr: <stand>	Hey, simdi Jellopy aramaya gidebilir miyiz?	</stand>

70.source_en: <connect>	Hey are we going to go hunting for jellopies today?	</connect>
70.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey, bugun Jellopy avina cikacak miyiz?	</connect>

71.source_en: <connect>	Yay, you're back, can we get some grub?	</connect>
71.translation_tr: <connect>	Yasasin, geri geldin, biraz yemek bulabilir miyiz?	</connect>

72.source_en: <connect>	I feel like lootin' today, let's find some good stuff.	</connect>
72.translation_tr: <connect>	Bugun ganimet toplamak istiyorum, guzel seyler bulalim.	</connect>

73.source_en: <connect>	Oh thank goodness you're back, I thought you might have forgotten me.	</connect>
73.translation_tr: <connect>	Ah, iyi ki geri geldin, beni unuttun sandim.	</connect>

74.source_en: <connect>	Someone tried taking me while you were gone! Please don't leave me again.	</connect>
74.translation_tr: <connect>	Sen yokken biri beni almaya calisti! Lutfen beni yine yalniz birakma.	</connect>

75.source_en: <levelup>	Leveled again? You know, I'm startin' to enjoy this.	</levelup>
75.translation_tr: <levelup>	Yine mi level atladin? Biliyor musun, bundan hoslanmaya basladim.	</levelup>

76.source_en: <levelup>	Yay, I'd give you a high five, but I kinda don't have any hands...	</levelup>
76.translation_tr: <levelup>	Yasasin, seninle cak yapardim ama pek elim yok...	</levelup>

77.source_en: <levelup>	Alright! Can we celebrate with some food?	</levelup>

78.source_en: <levelup>	Yeah! I think this means you should get us some fried jellopy.	</levelup>
78.translation_tr: <levelup>	Evet! Bence bu bize biraz kizarmis Jellopy alman gerektigi anlamina geliyor.	</levelup>

79.source_en: <levelup>	ALL YOUR JELLOPY ARE BELONG TO ME... er... I mean us...^^	</levelup>
79.translation_tr: <levelup>	BUTUN JELLOPYLERIN BENIM... ee... yani bizim...^^	</levelup>

82.source_en: <feeding>	Ooh yum~ that was nice, thank you.	</feeding>

84.source_en: <feeding>	Wow, that almost made me full!	</feeding>

87.source_en: <hunting>	HA! Take that you evil thing!	</hunting>
87.translation_tr: <hunting>	HA! Al bakalim bunu, seni kotu sey!	</hunting>

88.source_en: <hunting>	I hope one day I can help you more, you're my best bud.	</hunting>
88.translation_tr: <hunting>	Umarim bir gun sana daha cok yardim edebilirim, sen benim en iyi dostumsun.	</hunting>

89.source_en: <hunting>	Wow, what a shot, can you teach me that?	</hunting>
89.translation_tr: <hunting>	Vay, ne atisti, bana da ogretebilir misin?	</hunting>

90.source_en: <hunting>	Is it bad when they hit you so much?	</hunting>
90.translation_tr: <hunting>	Sana bu kadar vurmalari kotu bir sey mi?	</hunting>

92.source_en: <hunting>	Ha ha! You are the best!	</hunting>

93.source_en: <danger>	Oh please don't die, fly wing if you have to!	</danger>
93.translation_tr: <danger>	Ah lutfen olme, gerekirse Fly Wing kullan!	</danger>

94.source_en: <danger>	Don't push it, you're not invincible, heal up.	</danger>
94.translation_tr: <danger>	Fazla zorlama, yenilmez degilsin, kendini iyilestir.	</danger>

95.source_en: <danger>	Where's my apple? Please use it, heal yourself, don't die.	</danger>
95.translation_tr: <danger>	Elmami nereye koydum? Lutfen kullan, kendini iyilestir, olme.	</danger>

96.source_en: <danger>	I would protect you if I could, but... I don't think I'd stand a chance.	</danger>
96.translation_tr: <danger>	Yapabilsem seni korurdum ama... sanirim sansim olmazdi.	</danger>

97.source_en: <danger>	Are you alright?? Don't get hurt anymore!	</danger>
97.translation_tr: <danger>	Iyi misin?? Artik daha fazla yaralanma!	</danger>

98.source_en: <dead>	Is there anything I can do...? You don't look too good.	</dead>
98.translation_tr: <dead>	Yapabilecegim bir sey var mi...? Pek iyi gorunmuyorsun.	</dead>

99.source_en: <dead>	You did your best, but... let's not do that again, ok?	</dead>
99.translation_tr: <dead>	Elinden geleni yaptin ama... bunu bir daha yapmayalim, olur mu?	</dead>

100.source_en: <dead>	Stop lying there, get up, it's not over!	</dead>
100.translation_tr: <dead>	Orada yatmayi birak, kalk, daha bitmedi!	</dead>

101.source_en: <dead>	Hey, I found some loot... I promise to give it to you if you get up.	</dead>
101.translation_tr: <dead>	Hey, biraz ganimet buldum... kalkarsan sana verecegime soz veriyorum.	</dead>

102.source_en: <dead>	You aren't moving... *cry* Am I all alone..?	</dead>
102.translation_tr: <dead>	Hareket etmiyorsun... *aglar* Tek basima mi kaldim..?	</dead>

103.source_en: <stand>	A-a-and we're off, where are we goin' now? ^^	</stand>
103.translation_tr: <stand>	V-ve yola ciktik, simdi nereye gidiyoruz? ^^	</stand>

104.source_en: <stand>	Wow, we leaving already? You're on the move!	</stand>
104.translation_tr: <stand>	Vay, simdiden gidiyor muyuz? Hic durmuyorsun!	</stand>

105.source_en: <stand>	Hey, how come I don't have any hands...?	</stand>
105.translation_tr: <stand>	Hey, neden benim hic elim yok...?	</stand>

106.source_en: <stand>	You like me more then the other porings, don't you?	</stand>
106.translation_tr: <stand>	Beni diger Poringlerden daha cok seviyorsun, degil mi?	</stand>

107.source_en: <stand>	I think I picked up a ... oh never mind, I must have missed it...	</stand>
107.translation_tr: <stand>	Sanirim bir sey aldim... bos ver, galiba kacirdim...	</stand>

108.source_en: <stand>	I think I had an accident, let's leave quick.	</stand>
108.translation_tr: <stand>	Sanirim bir kaza oldu, cabuk gidelim.	</stand>

109.source_en: <connect>	*wraps around your leg* yay you're back.	</connect>

110.source_en: <connect>	Yay! More good food and traveling!	</connect>
110.translation_tr: <connect>	Yasasin! Daha cok guzel yemek ve yolculuk!	</connect>

111.source_en: <connect>	Why did you leave for so long? I'm ready, let's go!	</connect>
111.translation_tr: <connect>	Neden bu kadar uzun sure gittin? Hazirim, hadi gidelim!	</connect>

112.source_en: <connect>	All hail my master has returned!	</connect>

113.source_en: <connect>	So, where's that fried jellopy you promised me before?	</connect>
113.translation_tr: <connect>	Peki, daha once soz verdigin kizarmis Jellopy nerede?	</connect>

114.source_en: <connect>	Someone asked me about you while you were gone... hmm, who was it...	</connect>
114.translation_tr: <connect>	Sen yokken biri seni sordu... hmm, kimdi acaba...	</connect>

116.source_en: <levelup>	Yay, now we can go eat, right?	</levelup>
116.translation_tr: <levelup>	Yasasin, simdi yemek yemeye gidebiliriz, degil mi?	</levelup>

117.source_en: <levelup>	Good job! When do I get to level?	</levelup>
117.translation_tr: <levelup>	Iyi is! Ben ne zaman level atlayacagim?	</levelup>

118.source_en: <levelup>	Wow! Wings! Just like an Angelring! Teach me how to do that please?	</levelup>
118.translation_tr: <levelup>	Vay! Kanatlar! Tipki Angelring gibi! Bana da nasil yapildigini ogretir misin?	</levelup>

119.source_en: <levelup>	Booya! Looks like we're moving up!	</levelup>

122.source_en: <feeding>	Many thanks, this is really tasty!	</feeding>

123.source_en: <feeding>	Bananas again? With that many in me, I'd probably turn so yellow, and become a Drops?	</feeding>
123.translation_tr: <feeding>	Yine muz mu? Bu kadar cok yersem sararip bir Drops'a donusebilirim?	</feeding>

124.source_en: <feeding>	For the first time in my life... I'm full. You complete me.	</feeding>
124.translation_tr: <feeding>	Hayatimda ilk kez... doydum. Beni tamamliyorsun.	</feeding>

125.source_en: <feeding>	I think I'm gonna throw up.	</feeding>

127.source_en: <hunting>	*chomp*chomp*chomp* Sorry, I can't find my apple to give you.	</hunting>

128.source_en: <hunting>	Master, how come you never buy ME weapons or armor. I can fight too or do you not care about me?	</hunting>
128.translation_tr: <hunting>	Efendim, neden bana hic silah veya zirh almiyorsun? Ben de savasabilirim, yoksa beni umursamiyor musun?	</hunting>

129.source_en: <hunting>	Stop showing off... just kill it.	</hunting>

131.source_en: <hunting>	Can't we take a nap? I just ate!	</hunting>
131.translation_tr: <hunting>	Biraz uyuyamaz miyiz? Daha yeni yemek yedim!	</hunting>

132.source_en: <danger>	Oh!! Please someone help my master!!	</danger>
132.translation_tr: <danger>	Ah!! Lutfen biri efendime yardim etsin!!	</danger>

134.source_en: <danger>	What did I tell you... wearing that cape does not make you Superman!	</danger>
134.translation_tr: <danger>	Sana ne demistim... o pelerini takmak seni Superman yapmaz!	</danger>

135.source_en: <danger>	Don't die! Who's gonna be there for my Poring Academy Graduation?	</danger>
135.translation_tr: <danger>	Olme! Poring Akademisi mezuniyetimde kim olacak?	</danger>

137.source_en: <dead>	Oh no, the world may never know the joy that is you...	</dead>
137.translation_tr: <dead>	Ah hayir, dunya senin verdigin mutlulugu asla bilemeyebilir...	</dead>

138.source_en: <dead>	Oh no!! Player down! Player down! CHHHHRRRRISSSSSTTTYY!!!!	</dead>
138.translation_tr: <dead>	Ah hayir!! Oyuncu dustu! Oyuncu dustu! CHHHHRRRRISSSSSTTTYY!!!!	</dead>

139.source_en: <dead>	Where will I go?! What will I do?!	</dead>

140.source_en: <dead>	I'm sorry GOD-POING I promise not to loot again!! Please revive him T_T	</dead>
140.translation_tr: <dead>	Ozur dilerim GOD-POING, bir daha ganimet calmamaya soz veriyorum!! Lutfen onu dirilt T_T	</dead>

142.source_en: <dead>	Man... it's so embarrassing when you die...	</dead>
142.translation_tr: <dead>	Ah... oldugunde cok utanc verici oluyor...	</dead>

143.source_en: <stand>	I know it's embarrassing, but I love you, you know that? I want the whole world to know!	</stand>
143.translation_tr: <stand>	Utanc verici biliyorum ama seni seviyorum, biliyorsun degil mi? Tum dunya bilsin istiyorum!	</stand>

144.source_en: <stand>	What came first, the jellopy or the poring... hmm...	</stand>
144.translation_tr: <stand>	Once Jellopy mi vardi yoksa Poring mi... hmm...	</stand>

146.source_en: <stand>	Ooh, are we gonna go tame me a girlfriend now?	</stand>
146.translation_tr: <stand>	Ooh, simdi bana bir kiz arkadas evcillestirmeye mi gidiyoruz?	</stand>

147.source_en: <stand>	Hey, can we go to Morroc? I haven't visited my cousin in ages!	</stand>
147.translation_tr: <stand>	Hey, Morroc'a gidebilir miyiz? Kuzenimi cok uzun zamandir ziyaret etmedim!	</stand>

148.source_en: <stand>	I have to use the potty...	</stand>

149.source_en: <connect>	Yawn...so early! Don't you have any homework to do? Let me sleep in a little!	</connect>
149.translation_tr: <connect>	Esneme... cok erken! Yapacak odeven yok mu? Biraz daha uyuyayim!	</connect>

151.source_en: <connect>	Yay! Now we can go leveling again. ^^	</connect>
151.translation_tr: <connect>	Yasasin! Simdi tekrar level kasmaya gidebiliriz. ^^	</connect>

152.source_en: <connect>	Weee!! Lets go do a Bapho hunt!	</connect>

153.source_en: <connect>	I am not hungry! ^__^ But get some food just in case I want a snack ^_~	</connect>
153.translation_tr: <connect>	Ac degilim! ^__^ Ama atistirmak istersem diye biraz yemek al ^_~	</connect>

154.source_en: <levelup>	You are the best, there is no doubt...	</levelup>
154.translation_tr: <levelup>	Sen en iyisisin, hic suphe yok...	</levelup>

156.source_en: <levelup>	One step closer to server domination, muahaha.	</levelup>
156.translation_tr: <levelup>	Sunucu hakimiyetine bir adim daha, muahaha.	</levelup>

157.source_en: <levelup>	Yay!! You did it! Woohoo!! Yippee!!	</levelup>

161.source_en: <feeding>	Argh Noo!! I do not want to die from over eating!	</feeding>
161.translation_tr: <feeding>	Ah hayir!! Fazla yemekten olmek istemiyorum!	</feeding>

162.source_en: <feeding>	Mmnff.. n-no more food please, I beg you!	</feeding>
162.translation_tr: <feeding>	Mmnff.. l-lutfen daha fazla yemek verme, yalvariyorum!	</feeding>

163.source_en: <feeding>	Fattening me up for slaughter, eh? I'm watching you....	</feeding>
163.translation_tr: <feeding>	Beni kesim icin sismanlatiyorsun, ha? Seni izliyorum....	</feeding>

167.source_en: <hunting>	*burp* ... if we do not rest I think I'm going to be sick	</hunting>

168.source_en: <hunting>	Maaaster~, can we slow down? I'm feeling a lil' sick..	</hunting>
168.translation_tr: <hunting>	Efendiiim~, biraz yavaslayabilir miyiz? Biraz hasta hissediyorum..	</hunting>

169.source_en: <hunting>	Oh no, I think I'm going to...throw up....WATCH YOUR FEET!!.	</hunting>
169.translation_tr: <hunting>	Ah hayir, sanirim... kusacagim.... AYAKLARINA DIKKAT!!.	</hunting>

170.source_en: <hunting>	OMG so much loot... but... I can't take it, I'm so full *sob*	</hunting>
170.translation_tr: <hunting>	Aman tanrim, cok ganimet var... ama... alamiyorum, cok tokum *hickirir*	</hunting>

171.source_en: <danger>	I'd love it if I lost weight as fast as you lose hit points...	</danger>
171.translation_tr: <danger>	Sen HP kaybettigin kadar hizli kilo versem harika olurdu...	</danger>

172.source_en: <danger>	See, that's what happens when you overfeed me! It's bad karma!	</danger>
172.translation_tr: <danger>	Gordun mu, beni fazla beslersen boyle olur! Kotu karma!	</danger>

173.source_en: <danger>	I told you to stay away from those mace-wielding priests.	</danger>
173.translation_tr: <danger>	Sana topuz kullanan rahiplerden uzak dur demistim.	</danger>

174.source_en: <danger>	Here take this red pot I looted!	</danger>
174.translation_tr: <danger>	Al, buldugum bu kirmizi iksiri kullan!	</danger>

175.source_en: <dead>	Oh, this it is a good method to slim!	</dead>
175.translation_tr: <dead>	Ah, bu zayiflamak icin iyi bir yontem!	</dead>

176.source_en: <dead>	Next time, if you're going to need to heal	</dead>

177.source_en: <dead>	I'm sure you almost had it.. I mean, all those red numbers above your head meant we were winning right?	</dead>
177.translation_tr: <dead>	Eminim neredeyse basariyordun.. Yani basinin ustundeki tum o kirmizi sayilar kazandigimiz anlamina geliyordu, degil mi?	</dead>

178.source_en: <dead>	I told you , I told you , I told you!!	</dead>

181.source_en: <stand>	Maybe I should go see a doctor.. I feel sick..	</stand>
181.translation_tr: <stand>	Belki doktora gitmeliyim.. kendimi hasta hissediyorum..	</stand>

184.source_en: <connect>	Heal me. Free stuff. Tank me. Loot him. Ks him. .....sorry, I've been hanging around novices while you were away.	</connect>
184.translation_tr: <connect>	Beni iyilestir. Bedava esya. Tankla. Ganimetini al. KS yap. .....uzgunum, sen yokken novice'larla cok takildim.	</connect>

185.source_en: <connect>	hears, many people have confused me with a savage bebe... I need to slim NOW!!	</connect>
185.translation_tr: <connect>	Duyduguma gore bircok kisi beni Savage Bebe ile karistirmis... HEMEN zayiflamam lazim!!	</connect>

186.source_en: <connect>	Great, you're back.. and I'd bet you want to FEED ME MORE, HUH!?	</connect>
186.translation_tr: <connect>	Harika, geri geldin.. eminim BENI DAHA COK BESLEMEK istiyorsun, ha!?	</connect>

187.source_en: <connect>	Real life getting to be boring again?	</connect>
187.translation_tr: <connect>	Gercek hayat yine sikici mi olmaya basladi?	</connect>

188.source_en: <connect>	Hello! Do I start my diet today?	</connect>

189.source_en: <levelup>	Very well ... you will not have a skill to do slim, maybe?	</levelup>
189.translation_tr: <levelup>	Peki... belki beni zayiflatacak bir becerin yoktur?	</levelup>

190.source_en: <levelup>	There, you leveled, can we please nap now? I'm stuffed!	</levelup>
190.translation_tr: <levelup>	Iste, level atladin, simdi biraz uyuyabilir miyiz? Tikabasa doydum!	</levelup>

191.source_en: <levelup>	You're leveling up too fast... you're a bot, aren't you!	</levelup>
191.translation_tr: <levelup>	Cok hizli level atliyorsun... botsun, degil mi!	</levelup>

192.source_en: <levelup>	OMG you wouldn't believe it, I actually went out on a date with a girl poring! You want to meet her?	</levelup>
192.translation_tr: <levelup>	Aman tanrim, inanmazsin, gercekten bir kiz Poring ile bulusmaya ciktim! Onunla tanismak ister misin?	</levelup>

193.source_en: <levelup>	Another level? Can we go home now? I need rest.	</levelup>
193.translation_tr: <levelup>	Bir level daha mi? Simdi eve gidebilir miyiz? Dinlenmem gerek.	</levelup>

198.source_en: <feeding>	You have a great sense of time, I'm hungry!	</feeding>

199.source_en: <feeding>	Hey, do you hear that? My tummy's grumbling.	</feeding>
199.translation_tr: <feeding>	Hey, bunu duyuyor musun? Karnim gurulduyor.	</feeding>

200.source_en: <feeding>	Can I please have some more?	</feeding>

201.source_en: <hunting>	Hey, feed me before I get angry, you don't want to see me angry...	</hunting>
201.translation_tr: <hunting>	Hey, sinirlenmeden beni besle, beni sinirli gormek istemezsin...	</hunting>

202.source_en: <hunting>	Man, you hunt SOO slow... speed it up, then feed me.	</hunting>
202.translation_tr: <hunting>	Dostum, COK yavas avlaniyorsun... hizlan, sonra beni besle.	</hunting>

204.source_en: <hunting>	Okay, we'll make it even, we'll split the items 30/70, and you get the 30...	</hunting>
204.translation_tr: <hunting>	Tamam, adil olsun, esyalari 30/70 boleriz, sen 30'u alirsin...	</hunting>

205.source_en: <danger>	I would be helping you right now, I'm just so danged hungry...	</danger>
205.translation_tr: <danger>	Simdi sana yardim ederdim ama cok acim...	</danger>

206.source_en: <danger>	Hey, look at that your life is in the red, that's good right?	</danger>
206.translation_tr: <danger>	Hey, bak HP'n kirmiziya dondu, bu iyi bir sey degil mi?	</danger>

207.source_en: <dead>	Argh! Stand up! Who going to feed me now?!	</dead>
207.translation_tr: <dead>	Ah! Kalk! Simdi beni kim besleyecek?!	</dead>

208.source_en: <dead>	Sleeping on the job? Not a good idea...WAKEY WAKEY!	</dead>
208.translation_tr: <dead>	Is basinda uyumak mi? Iyi fikir degil... UYAN UYAN!	</dead>

209.source_en: <stand>	How about moving a lil'bit? Sport is good for you!	</stand>
209.translation_tr: <stand>	Biraz hareket etmeye ne dersin? Spor sana iyi gelir!	</stand>

210.source_en: <stand>	Ahhh I'm going to die of starvation!!	</stand>

211.source_en: <connect>	It's about time! I'm starving here!	</connect>

212.source_en: <connect>	G'Day! I heard that some other Drops got some pancakes... *hint hint*	</connect>
212.translation_tr: <connect>	Selam! Duydum ki bazi Dropslar pankek almis... *ima ima*	</connect>

219.source_en: <feeding>	At last!! You're finally treating me like a real drop!	</feeding>
219.translation_tr: <feeding>	Sonunda!! Bana gercek bir Drops gibi davraniyorsun!	</feeding>

222.source_en: <hunting>	Can I have some of those shiny objects?	</hunting>
222.translation_tr: <hunting>	O parlak seylerden biraz alabilir miyim?	</hunting>

224.source_en: <danger>	SOMEONE PLEASE... DON'T LET MY MASTER DIE!!! *cries*	</danger>
224.translation_tr: <danger>	BIRISI LUTFEN... EFENDIMIN OLMESINE IZIN VERMEYIN!!! *aglar*	</danger>

225.source_en: <danger>	Don't die! No more yummy for my tummy!	</danger>
225.translation_tr: <danger>	Olme! Yoksa mideme nefis yemek kalmaz!	</danger>

226.source_en: <dead>	Not again... You need some serious training... or a mental check.	</dead>
226.translation_tr: <dead>	Yine mi... Ciddi bir egitime... ya da zihinsel kontrole ihtiyacin var.	</dead>

228.source_en: <dead>	Who's going to feed me if you're sleeping?... you are sleeping aren't you... *poke* aren't you....?	</dead>
228.translation_tr: <dead>	Sen uyuyorsan beni kim besleyecek?... uyuyorsun degil mi... *durter* degil mi....?	</dead>

229.source_en: <stand>	Soooooooo... what did you eat today? Really? I'll tell you what I ate? NOTHING! I'm hungryyyyyy...	</stand>
229.translation_tr: <stand>	Pekiiii... bugun ne yedin? Gercekten mi? Ben ne yedim soyleyeyim mi? HICBIR SEY! Aciiiim...	</stand>

230.source_en: <stand>	We should travel the world, and find all kinds of rare things!... to eat	</stand>
230.translation_tr: <stand>	Dunyayi gezip her turlu nadir seyi bulmaliyiz!... yemek icin	</stand>

231.source_en: <stand>	Shouldn't you be finding me something to eat?	</stand>
231.translation_tr: <stand>	Bana yiyecek bir sey bulman gerekmiyor mu?	</stand>

232.source_en: <connect>	Yeah! I thought you'd never come back! Welcome back!	</connect>
232.translation_tr: <connect>	Evet! Hic geri gelmeyeceksin sandim! Hos geldin!	</connect>

233.source_en: <connect>	Heya-heya! Do I waited for you to eat, let's dine!	</connect>
233.translation_tr: <connect>	Heya-heya! Yemek icin seni bekledim, hadi yiyelim!	</connect>

234.source_en: <connect>	Hiya! Where we off to today?	</connect>

235.source_en: <levelup>	Good! You must be stronger to get money!	</levelup>
235.translation_tr: <levelup>	Guzel! Para kazanmak icin daha guclu olmalisin!	</levelup>

236.source_en: <levelup>	Wooopeee!! Does this mean I get more food?	</levelup>
236.translation_tr: <levelup>	Yasasin!! Bu daha fazla yemek alacagim anlamina mi geliyor?	</levelup>

237.source_en: <levelup>	Yay!... food...I mean, yay you leveled!	</levelup>
237.translation_tr: <levelup>	Yasasin!... yemek... yani, yasasin level atladin!	</levelup>

240.source_en: <feeding>	You may not like the herbs, but I love 'em!	</feeding>
240.translation_tr: <feeding>	Otlar senin hosuna gitmeyebilir ama ben bayiliyorum!	</feeding>

242.source_en: <hunting>	Weeeeeee this is fun! fun! fun!!	</hunting>

243.source_en: <hunting>	Kill it! Kill it! DIE DIE DIE	</hunting>
243.translation_tr: <hunting>	Oldur onu! Oldur onu! OL OL OL	</hunting>

245.source_en: <danger>	Uh Oh! You MIGHT want to check your health, because it isn't going up!	</danger>
245.translation_tr: <danger>	Eyvah! HP'ni kontrol etmek isteyebilirsin, cunku yukselmiyor!	</danger>

246.source_en: <dead>	It's not your fault, it just happens once in a time...	</dead>
246.translation_tr: <dead>	Senin hatan degil, bazen boyle seyler olur...	</dead>

247.source_en: <dead>	Hey, are you ok? You don't look too good.	</dead>
247.translation_tr: <dead>	Hey, iyi misin? Pek iyi gorunmuyorsun.	</dead>

248.source_en: <stand>	can I sit? Or am I always in this position?	</stand>
248.translation_tr: <stand>	Oturabilir miyim? Yoksa hep bu pozisyonda miyim?	</stand>

249.source_en: <stand>	Man are you gonna do something or should I go?	</stand>
249.translation_tr: <stand>	Dostum, bir sey yapacak misin yoksa ben gideyim mi?	</stand>

251.source_en: <connect>	Yes!!!! You are finally back, my prayers were heard!	</connect>
251.translation_tr: <connect>	Evet!!!! Sonunda geri geldin, dualarim duyuldu!	</connect>

256.source_en: <feeding>	Thank you, but I don't need it right now...	</feeding>
256.translation_tr: <feeding>	Tesekkurler ama su anda ihtiyacim yok...	</feeding>

257.source_en: <feeding>	Thank you its good, but...STOP FEEDING ME, IM FULL!!!	</feeding>
257.translation_tr: <feeding>	Tesekkurler, guzel ama...BENI BESLEMEYI BIRAK, DOYDUM!!!	</feeding>

258.source_en: <feeding>	I'm not hungry. I ate a big lunch!	</feeding>
258.translation_tr: <feeding>	Ac degilim. Buyuk bir ogle yemegi yedim!	</feeding>

259.source_en: <hunting>	Oooooohhh.. I'm too full to eat the stuff on the ground.	</hunting>
259.translation_tr: <hunting>	Oooooohhh.. yerdeki seyleri yiyemeyecek kadar tokum.	</hunting>

260.source_en: <hunting>	Whoa! Food just laying there! Coolies!	</hunting>

261.source_en: <hunting>	Hey! All the these monsters...you love me best, right?	</hunting>
261.translation_tr: <hunting>	Hey! Butun bu canavarlar arasinda... en cok beni seviyorsun, degil mi?	</hunting>

262.source_en: <danger>	Ok, Just calm, don't mind the blood running down from your head!!	</danger>
262.translation_tr: <danger>	Tamam, sakin ol, basindan akan kani umursama!!	</danger>

263.source_en: <dead>	Tsk.tsk.tsk. I'll be waiting at the respawn point.	</dead>

264.source_en: <dead>	OMG, that's a long walk, well at least I can go with you...	</dead>
264.translation_tr: <dead>	Aman tanrim, uzun bir yol, en azindan seninle gelebilirim...	</dead>

265.source_en: <dead>	Well, lets start walking, its a long way up there-__-''	</dead>
265.translation_tr: <dead>	Peki, yurumege baslayalim, oraya kadar uzun yol var -__-''	</dead>

266.source_en: <dead>	See! You couldn't kill it, I told you didn't I. Oh well, I'm full anyways.	</dead>
266.translation_tr: <dead>	Gordun mu! Onu olduremedin, sana soylemistim. Neyse, zaten tokum.	</dead>

267.source_en: <stand>	Dinner today was fine...but a lil bit too much ^^ next time don't feed me so much, but thanks!	</stand>
267.translation_tr: <stand>	Bugunku yemek guzeldi... ama biraz fazlaydi ^^ bir dahaki sefere bu kadar besleme, yine de tesekkurler!	</stand>

270.source_en: <connect>	Hey, there you are! I missed you!	</connect>

272.source_en: <levelup>	Level Up, SCORE for the team!	</levelup>

275.source_en: <feeding>	You can put your food in your *pipe*	</feeding>

276.source_en: <feeding>	What are you trying to do, give me food poisoning?	</feeding>
276.translation_tr: <feeding>	Ne yapmaya calisiyorsun, beni mi zehirleyeceksin?	</feeding>

277.source_en: <hunting>	No items for me today. I can't move, uff.	</hunting>
277.translation_tr: <hunting>	Bugun bana esya yok. Hareket edemiyorum, uff.	</hunting>

278.source_en: <hunting>	*burp* Do I have to fetch the items?	</hunting>

279.translation_tr: <danger>	Kan... kirmizi kan... bana havucu hatirlatiyor *urks*	</danger>

280.source_en: <danger>	You gonna dieee!! AAaaahhh your going to diee!!	</danger>

281.source_en: <dead>	Ehm...got enough sleep? stand up man! your so pruditly ...	</dead>
281.translation_tr: <dead>	Ehm... yeterince uyudun mu? Kalk dostum! cok tembelsin...	</dead>

284.source_en: <stand>	When I grow up, I wanna be Santa! Or at least have a Santa hat!	</stand>
284.translation_tr: <stand>	Buyuyunce Noel Baba olmak istiyorum! Ya da en azindan Noel Baba sapkam olsun!	</stand>

286.source_en: <connect>	Welcome back! Did you miss me?	</connect>

293.source_en: <feeding>	Thanks...I don't feel so good, maybe it was the apple you fed me.	</feeding>
293.translation_tr: <feeding>	Tesekkurler... kendimi pek iyi hissetmiyorum, belki verdigin elmadandir.	</feeding>

294.source_en: <feeding>	Thank you, I kept thinking I was lime Jell-O.	</feeding>
294.translation_tr: <feeding>	Tesekkurler, kendimi limonlu jole sanmaya baslamistim.	</feeding>

295.source_en: <feeding>	Thanks, I was so hungry. I hardly could skip.	</feeding>
295.translation_tr: <feeding>	Tesekkurler, cok actim. Zar zor ziplayabiliyordum.	</feeding>

296.source_en: <hunting>	That item on the ground looks mighty tasty!	</hunting>

298.source_en: <hunting>	Uh... sorry but your items mysteriously disappeared	</hunting>
298.translation_tr: <hunting>	Ee... uzgunum ama esyalarin gizemli sekilde kayboldu	</hunting>

299.source_en: <danger>	Is it just me or do I smell death?	</danger>
299.translation_tr: <danger>	Bana mi oyle geliyor, yoksa olum kokusu mu aliyorum?	</danger>

300.source_en: <danger>	Well IF you die, do u think I can eat your items?	</danger>
300.translation_tr: <danger>	EGER olursen, esyalarini yiyebilir miyim sence?	</danger>

301.source_en: <danger>	Easy does it, it's getting too hot.	</danger>

302.source_en: <dead>	This is no time to sleep, I need food!!!	</dead>
302.translation_tr: <dead>	Uyumanin zamani degil, yemege ihtiyacim var!!!	</dead>

304.source_en: <dead>	Are you sleeping because I think you forgot to do something, involving ME.	</dead>
304.translation_tr: <dead>	Uyuyor musun? Sanirim BENIMLE ilgili bir seyi yapmayi unuttun.	</dead>

305.source_en: <stand>	I sort of need food right about now...	</stand>
305.translation_tr: <stand>	Su anda biraz yemege ihtiyacim var...	</stand>

306.source_en: <stand>	Well doesn't standing take energy? I think we better eat.	</stand>
306.translation_tr: <stand>	Ayakta durmak enerji harcamiyor mu? Bence yemek yesek iyi olur.	</stand>

307.source_en: <stand>	When did you feed me the last time? I can't remember.	</stand>
307.translation_tr: <stand>	Beni en son ne zaman besledin? Hatirlayamiyorum.	</stand>

308.source_en: <connect>	You come timely, it's time to eat.	</connect>

309.source_en: <connect>	Hello there, bring any food with you?	</connect>
309.translation_tr: <connect>	Selam, yaninda yiyecek bir sey getirdin mi?	</connect>

310.source_en: <connect>	You are the best owner in the world... so don't you think a pet that is owned by the best owner should get breakfast?	</connect>
310.translation_tr: <connect>	Sen dunyanin en iyi sahibisin... en iyi sahibin peti de kahvaltiyi hak etmez mi?	</connect>

311.source_en: <levelup>	No time to celebrate, I NEED FOOD!	</levelup>

312.source_en: <levelup>	Booya! well that was hard work lets go eat!	</levelup>
312.translation_tr: <levelup>	Booya! Zor isti, hadi yemek yiyelim!	</levelup>

316.source_en: <feeding>	Did you know that a growing pet like me, needs more food?	</feeding>
316.translation_tr: <feeding>	Benim gibi buyuyen bir petin daha cok yemege ihtiyaci oldugunu biliyor muydun?	</feeding>

317.source_en: <hunting>	That Lunatic dropped a great looking carrot!	</hunting>
317.translation_tr: <hunting>	O Lunatic harika gorunen bir havuc dusurdu!	</hunting>

318.source_en: <hunting>	When you kill that thing can we go eat?	</hunting>
318.translation_tr: <hunting>	Onu oldurdukten sonra yemek yemeye gidebilir miyiz?	</hunting>

319.source_en: <danger>	Never mind you eating that! What about me!!!	</danger>
319.translation_tr: <danger>	Onu senin yemen bos ver! Ya ben!!!	</danger>

320.source_en: <danger>	Remember when its red it means you're going to die and you need to feed me.	</danger>
320.translation_tr: <danger>	Unutma, kirmiziysa oleceksin demektir ve beni beslemelisin.	</danger>

321.source_en: <dead>	I'll just grab some food from your pocket....	</dead>

322.source_en: <dead>	So since your napping think we can go get a burger after you wake up? You are waking up right?	</dead>
322.translation_tr: <dead>	Madem uyuyorsun, uyaninca burger almaya gidebilir miyiz? Uyanacaksin degil mi?	</dead>

323.source_en: <stand>	I'm so hungry I could eat at Arbys!	</stand>
323.translation_tr: <stand>	O kadar acim ki Arby's'de bile yiyebilirim!	</stand>

324.source_en: <stand>	Do you think I look better than the Porings?	</stand>
324.translation_tr: <stand>	Sence Poringlerden daha iyi gorunuyor muyum?	</stand>

325.source_en: <stand>	Since were standing here doing nothing and smelling delicious food.. do you think we can go get some of that delicious food?	</stand>
325.translation_tr: <stand>	Burada bos bos durup guzel yemek kokulari aliyorken... biraz o yemeklerden almaya gidelim mi?	</stand>

326.source_en: <connect>	I got a yearning' for some food!	</connect>

327.source_en: <connect>	A good breakfast consist of a lot of food and feeding your pet.	</connect>
327.translation_tr: <connect>	Iyi bir kahvalti bol yemek ve petini beslemekten olusur.	</connect>

328.source_en: <levelup>	Does that big light above you mean dinner time?	</levelup>
328.translation_tr: <levelup>	Basinin ustundeki buyuk isik yemek zamani demek mi?	</levelup>

329.source_en: <levelup>	Did you know that energy comes from food? well I didn't know that, lets go see if that's true.	</levelup>
329.translation_tr: <levelup>	Enerjinin yemekten geldigini biliyor muydun? Ben bilmiyordum, dogru mu gidip gorelim.	</levelup>

334.source_en: <feeding>	Tummy status, normal. Food incoming, normal. All systems check lets go!	</feeding>
334.translation_tr: <feeding>	Mide durumu normal. Yemek girisi normal. Tum sistemler tamam, hadi gidelim!	</feeding>

335.source_en: <hunting>	That lunatic looks good for tonight's BBQ!	</hunting>
335.translation_tr: <hunting>	O Lunatic bu aksamki mangal icin iyi gorunuyor!	</hunting>

336.source_en: <hunting>	I must say that was one of the best battles you had! You were like BOOM and then BAM and then WOOP POW!!	</hunting>
336.translation_tr: <hunting>	Soylemeden edemem, en iyi savaslarindan biriydi! Once BOOM, sonra BAM, sonra WOOP POW!!	</hunting>

337.source_en: <danger>	It's only a flesh wound, just do what I do, EAT!!!	</danger>
337.translation_tr: <danger>	Sadece et yarasi, benim yaptigimi yap, YE!!!	</danger>

338.source_en: <danger>	Excuse me Mr. Person who I don't know could you share you all so great healing powers with my unfortunate friend over there?	</danger>
338.translation_tr: <danger>	Affedersiniz tanimadigim Bay Kisi, harika iyilestirme gucunuzu su talihsiz arkadasimla paylasir misiniz?	</danger>

340.source_en: <dead>	Stand up please, the ground is dirty!	</dead>

341.source_en: <dead>	Being alive is the BESTEST!!! Don't you think so *poke* uh oh	</dead>
341.translation_tr: <dead>	Hayatta olmak EN GUZELI!!! Sence de oyle degil mi *durter* eyvah	</dead>

344.source_en: <stand>	On my birthday can I have a car? I think I can drive without hands.	</stand>
344.translation_tr: <stand>	Dogum gunumde araba alabilir miyim? Ellerim olmadan da surebilirim bence.	</stand>

345.source_en: <connect>	Bing, Bong, Bing, Bong, look I think getting late I think you should go....... JUST KIDDING ^_^	</connect>
345.translation_tr: <connect>	Bing, Bong, Bing, Bong, bak gec oluyor, bence gitmelisin....... SADECE SAKA ^_^	</connect>

348.source_en: <levelup>	BOOYA Grandma... er.... I mean owner =P	</levelup>

352.source_en: <feeding>	Your just like that cat who always came back but instead you have food.	</feeding>
352.translation_tr: <feeding>	Hep geri donen o kedi gibisin ama sen yemekle geliyorsun.	</feeding>

353.source_en: <hunting>	*weez* *cough* you look mighty tired won't you *puff* *weez* rest...?	</hunting>
353.translation_tr: <hunting>	*hirlama* *oksuruk* cok yorgun gorunuyorsun, biraz *nefes* *hirlama* dinlenmeyecek misin...?	</hunting>

354.source_en: <hunting>	Are you about to fall to be funny? because I think you should fall down on a bed.	</hunting>
354.translation_tr: <hunting>	Komik olmak icin mi duseceksin? Bence bir yataga dusmelisin.	</hunting>

355.source_en: <hunting>	Just attack, I'll lay a false scent.	</hunting>
355.translation_tr: <hunting>	Sen saldir, ben sahte bir koku izi birakirim.	</hunting>

357.source_en: <danger>	No, I don't like red. I prefer green, just take care!	</danger>
357.translation_tr: <danger>	Hayir, kirmiziyi sevmem. Yesili tercih ederim, dikkat et!	</danger>

358.source_en: <danger>	So as I was saying there was the bee and... I see your going to sleep from my story oh wait that red thing means...	</danger>
358.translation_tr: <danger>	Dedigim gibi bir ari vardi ve... hikayemden uykuya daliyorsun sandim, dur o kirmizi sey demek ki...	</danger>

359.source_en: <dead>	You have gas too? Yours must be worse!	</dead>
359.translation_tr: <dead>	Sende de gaz mi var? Seninki daha kotu olmali!	</dead>

360.source_en: <dead>	Doctor, is the heart suppose to move?	</dead>
360.translation_tr: <dead>	Doktor, kalbin hareket etmesi gerekiyor mu?	</dead>

361.source_en: <stand>	I shouldn't have eaten that unripe apple...	</stand>

362.source_en: <stand>	Food? Did you know that you start losing levels when you eat too much? ( hehe I don't think he's going to know that ^_^ )	</stand>
362.translation_tr: <stand>	Yemek mi? Cok yiyince level kaybetmeye basladigini biliyor muydun? ( hehe bunu bildigini sanmiyorum ^_^ )	</stand>

363.source_en: <stand>	A little break is always good.	</stand>
363.translation_tr: <stand>	Kisa bir mola her zaman iyidir.	</stand>

364.source_en: <connect>	No more pie...maybe one more piece...Oh welcome back!	</connect>
364.translation_tr: <connect>	Daha fazla turta yok... belki bir dilim daha... Ah hos geldin!	</connect>

365.source_en: <connect>	Breakfast? It's only the morning, don't you have breakfast in like another 10 hours or so?	</connect>
365.translation_tr: <connect>	Kahvalti mi? Daha sabah, kahvaltiya daha 10 saat falan yok mu?	</connect>

366.source_en: <levelup>	I would blow a whistle, but I have no hands!	</levelup>

367.source_en: <levelup>	Can I choose what to do? Yay! Lets go eat some tofu turkey!!	</levelup>
367.translation_tr: <levelup>	Ne yapacagimizi ben secebilir miyim? Yasasin! Hadi tofu hindisi yiyelim!!	</levelup>

370.source_en: <feeding>	If you feed me at this rate, you'll turn me into a Big Foot!!!	</feeding>
370.translation_tr: <feeding>	Beni bu hizla beslersen Big Foot'a cevireceksin!!!	</feeding>

371.source_en: <feeding>	Do you want me to grow bigger than you? Well sorry but instead of going up, for some reason it's going sideways.	</feeding>
371.translation_tr: <feeding>	Senden daha buyuk olmami mi istiyorsun? Uzgunum ama nedense yukari degil yanlara buyuyorum.	</feeding>

372.source_en: <feeding>	Stop it! Soon I can't skip anymore, you'll have to roll me!	</feeding>
372.translation_tr: <feeding>	Dur artik! Yakinda ziplayamayacagim, beni yuvarlaman gerekecek!	</feeding>

373.source_en: <hunting>	I'm going to hurl all this food on the ground is making me hungry!	</hunting>
373.translation_tr: <hunting>	Kusacagim, yerdeki tum bu yemekler beni aciktiriyor!	</hunting>

375.source_en: <hunting>	Not that fast, I can't keep pace.	</hunting>

376.source_en: <danger>	I feel bloated what about you?	</danger>

377.source_en: <danger>	Blood? Ketchup? Fries? No not more food!	</danger>
377.translation_tr: <danger>	Kan mi? Kecap mi? Patates mi? Hayir, daha fazla yemek istemiyorum!	</danger>

378.source_en: <danger>	At least we're now at the same eye-level.	</danger>
378.translation_tr: <danger>	En azindan simdi goz hizamiz ayni.	</danger>

379.source_en: <dead>	You have red stuff coming out of your back.	</dead>

380.source_en: <dead>	Well Let's see, me over filling with food, plus you closing your eyes, equals me not eating anymore ^_^	</dead>
380.translation_tr: <dead>	Bakalim, benim tikabasa dolmam arti senin gozlerini kapatman esittir artik yemek yiyememem ^_^	</dead>

381.source_en: <stand>	While we're here lets make a Hammock!	</stand>

382.source_en: <stand>	I take a nap. Could you give me my green Pajama?	</stand>
382.translation_tr: <stand>	Biraz uyuyacagim. Yesil pijamami verir misin?	</stand>

383.source_en: <stand>	Well tell me when your going to move, I'm just going to go there and sit my little plump body right there.	</stand>
383.translation_tr: <stand>	Hareket edecegin zaman soyle, ben suraya gidip tombul bedenimi oturtacagim.	</stand>

384.source_en: <connect>	Welcome back, I think I lost weight while you were gone!	</connect>
384.translation_tr: <connect>	Hos geldin, sen yokken kilo verdim galiba!	</connect>

385.source_en: <connect>	Well lets go! Food? What's Food?	</connect>
385.translation_tr: <connect>	Hadi gidelim! Yemek mi? Yemek ne ki?	</connect>

386.source_en: <connect>	I've waited until I was green. At last! ^_^	</connect>

387.source_en: <levelup>	Nice One!!! Can you buy me a Stairmaster?	</levelup>
387.translation_tr: <levelup>	Guzel!!! Bana bir StairMaster alabilir misin?	</levelup>

389.source_en: <levelup>	Well since you achieved something. A diet is what I think I should achieve.	</levelup>
389.translation_tr: <levelup>	Sen bir sey basardin, ben de diyeti basarmaliyim bence.	</levelup>

394.source_en: <feeding>	*rwar* I want more! Give me more, I'm really hungry!	</feeding>
394.translation_tr: <feeding>	*rwar* Daha istiyorum! Daha ver, gercekten acim!	</feeding>

395.source_en: <feeding>	Mmm, more more more! I'm so hungry!	</feeding>
395.translation_tr: <feeding>	Mmm, daha daha daha! Cok acim!	</feeding>

396.source_en: <hunting>	Ugh, why fight? feed me please!.	</hunting>
396.translation_tr: <hunting>	Off, neden savasiyoruz? Lutfen beni besle!.	</hunting>

397.source_en: <hunting>	Bunny to Rabbit, target sighted, carrots are good to eat, I repeat, carrots are good to eat.	</hunting>
397.translation_tr: <hunting>	Tavsandan Tavsana, hedef goruldu, havuc yemek iyidir, tekrar ediyorum, havuc yemek iyidir.	</hunting>

398.source_en: <hunting>	Hey, I'm gonna go look around for some carrots, I'm hungry..	</hunting>
398.translation_tr: <hunting>	Hey, biraz havuc aramaya gidiyorum, acim..	</hunting>

399.source_en: <danger>	Don't complain to me about being hurt, I'm starving!!	</danger>
399.translation_tr: <danger>	Yaralandin diye bana yakinma, acliktan oluyorum!!	</danger>

400.source_en: <danger>	If you die, would you mind me checking your corpse for carrots?.	</danger>
400.translation_tr: <danger>	Olursen cesedinde havuc aramamin sakincasi olur mu?.	</danger>

401.source_en: <danger>	Eep! Run away! Run away! Keep running!	</danger>
401.translation_tr: <danger>	Iyy! Kac! Kac! Kosmaya devam et!	</danger>

402.source_en: <dead>	HA! You're dead... can I go now?	</dead>

403.source_en: <dead>	Does this mean I'm free to go now?	</dead>
403.translation_tr: <dead>	Bu simdi gitmekte ozgur oldugum anlamina mi geliyor?	</dead>

404.source_en: <dead>	... I'm... so hungry... but, I haven't been fed... in so long... must... go on....	</dead>
404.translation_tr: <dead>	... Cok... acim... ama... cok uzun zamandir beslenmedim... devam... etmeliyim....	</dead>

405.source_en: <dead>	Mind if I check your bag for some carrots?... wait, you're dead,	</dead>
405.translation_tr: <dead>	Cantanda havuc aramam sorun olur mu?... dur, sen oldun,	</dead>

406.source_en: <dead>	Tea?... no, you're dead, what're you going to do with tea... ha!	</dead>
406.translation_tr: <dead>	Cay mi?... yok, sen oldun, cayla ne yapacaksin ki... ha!	</dead>

407.source_en: <stand>	Hey while you're up, get me some food will you?	</stand>
407.translation_tr: <stand>	Hey ayaktayken bana biraz yemek alir misin?	</stand>

408.source_en: <stand>	Hey, I'm hungry are we going to find me some food?	</stand>
408.translation_tr: <stand>	Hey, acim, bana yemek bulmaya gidecek miyiz?	</stand>

410.source_en: <connect>	Oh my gosh, where have you been I'm so hungry!	</connect>

411.source_en: <connect>	Feed me or you'll find some nice pebbles in your shoes...	</connect>
411.translation_tr: <connect>	Beni besle yoksa ayakkabinda guzel taslar bulursun...	</connect>

412.source_en: <connect>	.... you...forgot ...to ...FEED ME!! ...Feed me, feed me, feed me, feed me!	</connect>
412.translation_tr: <connect>	.... beni... BESLEMEYI... unuttun!! ...Besle beni, besle, besle, besle!	</connect>

413.source_en: <connect>	I'm a Lunatic, not crazy. I know when I'm hungry and I'M HUNGRY.	</connect>
413.translation_tr: <connect>	Ben Lunatic'im, deli degilim. Ne zaman ac oldugumu bilirim ve ACIM.	</connect>

414.source_en: <connect>	You know, you look like you're going to have a bad hare day... Why? Because you forgot to feed me, so feed me already!	</connect>
414.translation_tr: <connect>	Biliyor musun, kotu bir tavsan gunu gecireceksin gibi... Neden mi? Beni beslemeyi unuttun, artik besle!	</connect>

415.source_en: <levelup>	Okay, you leveled... now go get me some food before I start leaving little presents all over the place.	</levelup>
415.translation_tr: <levelup>	Tamam, level atladin... simdi her yere kucuk hediyeler birakmadan once bana yemek bul.	</levelup>

416.source_en: <levelup>	Oh... yay... you get a level but what do I get? Food? No, well why not? I've been patient!	</levelup>
416.translation_tr: <levelup>	Ah... yasasin... sen level aldin, ben ne aliyorum? Yemek mi? Hayir mi, neden? Sabirliydim!	</levelup>

417.source_en: <levelup>	Oh joy, now you can get me some carrots, right?	</levelup>
417.translation_tr: <levelup>	Ne guzel, simdi bana havuc alabilirsin, degil mi?	</levelup>

418.source_en: <levelup>	So um, I'm happy you leveled and all, but when do I get to eat?	</levelup>
418.translation_tr: <levelup>	Ee, level atladigin icin mutluyum ama ben ne zaman yemek yiyecegim?	</levelup>

421.source_en: <feeding>	Hey, don't be stingy, keep it coming!	</feeding>

422.source_en: <feeding>	Yay, food... now I can lay off the grass for a little...	</feeding>
422.translation_tr: <feeding>	Yasasin, yemek... simdi biraz ot yemeye ara verebilirim...	</feeding>

423.source_en: <feeding>	Don't stop, keep it coming, I'm still a bit hungry.	</feeding>
423.translation_tr: <feeding>	Durma, devam et, hala biraz acim.	</feeding>

424.source_en: <feeding>	Hey, not too bad... almost got me full.. almost.	</feeding>
424.translation_tr: <feeding>	Hey, fena degil... neredeyse doydum.. neredeyse.	</feeding>

425.source_en: <hunting>	I may be cute to look at, but really I'm a nibbling machine!	</hunting>
425.translation_tr: <hunting>	Tatli gorunebilirim ama aslinda kemirme makinesiyim!	</hunting>

426.source_en: <hunting>	*rwar!* c'mon let's go, you and me I'll take ya on, no problem.	</hunting>
426.translation_tr: <hunting>	*rwar!* hadi gel, sen ve ben, seninle kapisirim, sorun yok.	</hunting>

427.source_en: <hunting>	If you keep feeding me the carrots, I'll keep bringing on the pain.	</hunting>
427.translation_tr: <hunting>	Beni havucla beslemeye devam et, ben de aci vermeye devam edeyim.	</hunting>

428.source_en: <hunting>	It's alright, I can take care of myself... eek! Killitkillitkillit!.	</hunting>
428.translation_tr: <hunting>	Sorun yok, kendime bakabilirim... iyy! Olduronuolduronuolduronu!.	</hunting>

429.source_en: <hunting>	If I help, do I get anything too, perhaps food?	</hunting>
429.translation_tr: <hunting>	Yardim edersem ben de bir sey alir miyim, mesela yemek?	</hunting>

430.source_en: <danger>	Yeah, like I was going to risk my soft fluffy fur to save you, you haven't fed me lately.	</danger>
430.translation_tr: <danger>	Tabii, yumusacik tuylerimi seni kurtarmak icin riske atacaktim sanki; son zamanlarda beni beslemedin.	</danger>

431.source_en: <danger>	If you're going die, would you mind telling me where the food is so I don't starve to death?	</danger>
431.translation_tr: <danger>	Oleceksen acliktan olmemem icin yemegin nerede oldugunu soyler misin?	</danger>

432.source_en: <danger>	You're about to die, tell me where the food is and I'll think about healing you.	</danger>
432.translation_tr: <danger>	Olmek uzeresin, yemegin nerede oldugunu soyle de seni iyilestirmeyi dusuneyim.	</danger>

433.source_en: <dead>	If you had fed me, I might have healed you and you would by lying there dead.	</dead>
433.translation_tr: <dead>	Beni besleseydin belki seni iyilestirirdim ve simdi orada olu yatmazdin.	</dead>

434.source_en: <dead>	I wonder what you taste like...	</dead>

435.source_en: <dead>	Help! Help! Somebody please resurrect my master please, please pretty please.	</dead>
435.translation_tr: <dead>	Yardim! Yardim! Biri lutfen efendimi diriltsin, lutfen, cok lutfen.	</dead>

436.source_en: <dead>	I'm going to go find some clover if you're going to just going to lie there.	</dead>
436.translation_tr: <dead>	Sen orada oylece yatacaksan ben biraz yonca bulmaya gidiyorum.	</dead>

437.source_en: <dead>	*sigh* now why'd you go and do that? Now what am I supposed to do for food?	</dead>
437.translation_tr: <dead>	*ic ceker* neden gidip bunu yaptin? Simdi yemek icin ne yapacagim?	</dead>

438.source_en: <stand>	I really don't think the other Lunatics get fed as little as I do.	</stand>
438.translation_tr: <stand>	Diger Lunaticlerin benim kadar az beslendigini hic sanmiyorum.	</stand>

439.source_en: <stand>	Hey, no, don't stand, I can't reach the food bag if you stand.	</stand>
439.translation_tr: <stand>	Hey, hayir, ayakta durma, durursan yemek cantasina ulasamiyorum.	</stand>

440.source_en: <stand>	Um, if you're going to leave, would you mind at least leaving some food for me?	</stand>
440.translation_tr: <stand>	Ee, gideceksen en azindan bana biraz yemek birakir misin?	</stand>

441.source_en: <stand>	Hey! That other Lunatic's eating, how come I'm not?	</stand>
441.translation_tr: <stand>	Hey! Diger Lunatic yemek yiyor, ben neden yemiyorum?	</stand>

442.source_en: <connect>	Hey welcome back! ... get me food.	</connect>
442.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey hos geldin! ... bana yemek getir.	</connect>

443.source_en: <connect>	I need food... now... please... oh... and um... Hi, welcome back.	</connect>
443.translation_tr: <connect>	Yemek lazim... simdi... lutfen... ah... ve ee... Selam, hos geldin.	</connect>

444.source_en: <connect>	I was just about to run off and find food, but since you're here. Feed me?	</connect>
444.translation_tr: <connect>	Tam yemek bulmaya kacacaktim ama sen geldin. Beni besler misin?	</connect>

445.source_en: <levelup>	Yay, good job. Let's celebrate by feeding the cute Lunatic!	</levelup>
445.translation_tr: <levelup>	Yasasin, iyi is. Tatli Lunatic'i besleyerek kutlayalim!	</levelup>

449.source_en: <feeding>	Mmm, that nearly hit the spot, I think I'm good for a bit, thanks.	</feeding>
449.translation_tr: <feeding>	Mmm, neredeyse tam oldu, bir sure idare ederim, tesekkurler.	</feeding>

450.source_en: <feeding>	*rwar* more, more, yum, yum, *munch* *gobble* *burp* aahh... thank you.	</feeding>
450.translation_tr: <feeding>	*rwar* daha, daha, nefis, nefis, *ham* *hapur* *gegirir* aahh... tesekkurler.	</feeding>

451.source_en: <feeding>	Oh, that was quite good, thank you very much.	</feeding>

452.source_en: <hunting>	Headshot! Headshot! Go for the headshot!	</hunting>

453.source_en: <hunting>	Go master go! Kill it for all the other Lunatics who live in fear!	</hunting>
453.translation_tr: <hunting>	Hadi efendim hadi! Korku icinde yasayan tum Lunaticler icin onu oldur!	</hunting>

454.source_en: <hunting>	Ooh watch it! Duck! Dodge! Attack!! Erm, okay, I'll stop...I'll just watch.	</hunting>
454.translation_tr: <hunting>	Ooh dikkat! Egil! Kac! Saldir!! Ee, tamam susuyorum... sadece izleyecegim.	</hunting>

455.source_en: <danger>	Oh no! You're bleeding!! Makeitstopmakeitstopmakeitstop! I hate the sight of red...	</danger>
455.translation_tr: <danger>	Ah hayir! Kaniyorsun!! Durdurunodurdurunodurdurun! Kirmizi gormekten nefret ederim...	</danger>

456.source_en: <danger>	Someone heal my master please!! He's really hurt, please someone please?	</danger>
456.translation_tr: <danger>	Biri lutfen efendimi iyilestirsin!! Cok yarali, lutfen biri yardim etsin?	</danger>

457.source_en: <dead>	Dead?! You can't be dead, you were just alive! Oh WHY, WHY GOD-POING WHY-Y-y-y....Zzz....Zzz....	</dead>
457.translation_tr: <dead>	Olu mu?! Olamazsin, az once yasiyordun! Ah NEDEN, NEDEN GOD-POING NEDEN-N-n-n....Zzz....Zzz....	</dead>

458.source_en: <dead>	You know, I was just starting to enjoy watching you kill everything, but now look at you.	</dead>
458.translation_tr: <dead>	Her seyi oldurmeni izlemekten yeni keyif almaya baslamistim ama simdi haline bak.	</dead>

459.source_en: <dead>	Don't worry, I'll make sure you get the right burial you deserve.	</dead>
459.translation_tr: <dead>	Endiselenme, hak ettigin gibi gomulmeni saglayacagim.	</dead>

460.source_en: <dead>	I swear, if I could bring you back to life, I would. I'm so sorry...	</dead>
460.translation_tr: <dead>	Yemin ederim, seni hayata dondurebilseydim yapardim. Cok uzgunum...	</dead>

461.source_en: <dead>	Alright, time to get up... c'mon, get up... get.... up...? *poke*... OH NO, WHEN DID YOU DIE?	</dead>
461.translation_tr: <dead>	Tamam, kalkma zamani... hadi, kalk... kalk....? *durter*... AH HAYIR, NE ZAMAN OLDUN?	</dead>

462.source_en: <stand>	Wow, you're tall...when did you get that tall?	</stand>
462.translation_tr: <stand>	Vay, uzunsun... ne zaman bu kadar uzadin?	</stand>

463.source_en: <stand>	I'm sorry I made those bad jokes about your hare-y legs... they're not that bad... soft like me.	</stand>
463.translation_tr: <stand>	Tavsan tuyleri gibi bacaklarinla dalga gectigim icin uzgunum... o kadar kotu degiller... benim gibi yumusak.	</stand>

464.source_en: <stand>	Do you... snu... know ... poojamungo...why they call us lunatics? ... smhuma-awia... I don't know why... odd huh?	</stand>
464.translation_tr: <stand>	Biliyor... musun... poojamungo... bize neden Lunatic diyorlar?... smhuma-awia... ben de bilmiyorum... garip degil mi?	</stand>

465.source_en: <stand>	C'mon, admit you love me... how can you not? I'm so cute n'fluffy!	</stand>
465.translation_tr: <stand>	Hadi, beni sevdigini kabul et... nasil sevmezsin? Cok tatli ve tuyliyum!	</stand>

466.source_en: <stand>	Feathers... come... from birds, right? So why do we drop them?	</stand>
466.translation_tr: <stand>	Tuyler... kuslardan gelir, degil mi? O zaman biz neden dusuruyoruz?	</stand>

467.source_en: <stand>	Ooh, where ya going? Do I get to go too?	</stand>
467.translation_tr: <stand>	Ooh, nereye gidiyorsun? Ben de gelebilir miyim?	</stand>

468.source_en: <connect>	*grr* ... *rwar*..... *snarl*.... eep! You caught me practicing for our next battle.	</connect>
468.translation_tr: <connect>	*grr* ... *rwar*..... *hirlar*.... iyy! Bir sonraki savas icin calisirken yakaladin.	</connect>

469.source_en: <connect>	I used your money to increase my bunny card collection.	</connect>
469.translation_tr: <connect>	Parani tavsan karti koleksiyonumu buyutmek icin kullandim.	</connect>

470.source_en: <connect>	Good evening to you, do you have a reservation?	</connect>

471.source_en: <connect>	I dreamt we found lots of rare items today!	</connect>
471.translation_tr: <connect>	Bugun cok nadir esya buldugumuzu gordum ruyamda!	</connect>

472.source_en: <levelup>	Cool, now you can leech off me... or is it the other way around?	</levelup>
472.translation_tr: <levelup>	Guzel, simdi benden leech yapabilirsin... yoksa tam tersi mi?	</levelup>

473.source_en: <levelup>	Yay, we've had a breakthrough, you get a gold star.	</levelup>
473.translation_tr: <levelup>	Yasasin, ilerleme kaydettik, sana altin yildiz.	</levelup>

477.translation_tr: <feeding>	Tamam, tamam, daha fazla havuc yok...	</feeding>

480.source_en: <hunting>	Do I look fat to you from this angle?	</hunting>
480.translation_tr: <hunting>	Bu acidan sana sisman mi gorunuyorum?	</hunting>

481.source_en: <hunting>	Why do you always have to kill kill kill, why not plant a flower for once?	</hunting>
481.translation_tr: <hunting>	Neden hep oldur oldur oldur, bir kere de cicek eksen olmaz mi?	</hunting>

483.source_en: <hunting>	Here I come to save the daaaaay~!	</hunting>

484.source_en: <danger>	Don't start complaining you're about to die, look at me. You think I'm gonna live?	</danger>
484.translation_tr: <danger>	Olmek uzeresin diye yakinmaya baslama, bana bak. Sence ben yasayacak miyim?	</danger>

485.source_en: <danger>	And.... use a pot... c'mon ... you can do it, you know you want to... c'mon.	</danger>
485.translation_tr: <danger>	Ve.... iksir kullan... hadi... yapabilirsin, istedigini biliyorsun... hadi.	</danger>

486.source_en: <danger>	Aah it's the Knights who say ni, RUN AWAY! RUN AWAY!	</danger>

487.source_en: <danger>	Hey, don't you go bleeding all over my soft white fluffy fur, I just had it groomed for my date tonight.	</danger>
487.translation_tr: <danger>	Hey, yumusak beyaz tuylerimin ustune kanama, bu geceki bulusmam icin yeni tarattim.	</danger>

489.source_en: <dead>	How about a dead time story? Would ya like that little fellah?	</dead>
489.translation_tr: <dead>	Bir olum zamani hikayesine ne dersin? Ister misin ufaklik?	</dead>

490.source_en: <dead>	You know, you really need to stop dying... I worry about you sometimes you know that?	</dead>
490.translation_tr: <dead>	Biliyor musun, artik olmeyi birakmalisin... bazen senin icin endiseleniyorum.	</dead>

491.source_en: <stand>	*BURP* Excuse me... all those carrots... I get no protein...	</stand>
491.translation_tr: <stand>	*GEGIRIR* Affedersin... tum o havuclar... hic protein alamiyorum...	</stand>

492.source_en: <stand>	I ...fear... the clowns... and... magicians... keep them away.... *shiver*	</stand>
492.translation_tr: <stand>	Ben... palyacolardan... ve... sihirbazlardan korkarim... uzak tut.... *titreme*	</stand>

493.source_en: <stand>	Hey, psst, down here... STOP STEPPING ON ME!!	</stand>
493.translation_tr: <stand>	Hey, psst, asagi bak... USTUME BASMAYI BIRAK!!	</stand>

494.source_en: <stand>	It's hard to look cute when you're as stuffed fat as I am...	</stand>
494.translation_tr: <stand>	Benim kadar tikabasa sisman olunca tatli gorunmek zor...	</stand>

495.source_en: <stand>	Look at me! I'm the sexiest Lunatic alive! *squeak*	</stand>
495.translation_tr: <stand>	Bana bak! Yasayan en cekici Lunatic benim! *cik*	</stand>

496.source_en: <connect>	Ah good, you're back, now my minion GO GO GO!	</connect>
496.translation_tr: <connect>	Ah guzel, geri geldin, simdi hizmetkarim HADI HADI HADI!	</connect>

497.source_en: <connect>	It's about time you got back, I need a workout, let's go a'huntin'	</connect>
497.translation_tr: <connect>	Donmenin zamani gelmisti, egzersize ihtiyacim var, hadi ava!	</connect>

498.source_en: <connect>	I got a bit greedy and ate all of our stash of carrots...	</connect>
498.translation_tr: <connect>	Biraz acgozlu davrandim ve tum havuc stokumuzu yedim...	</connect>

499.source_en: <levelup>	Yay, nice going, now when do I get to?	</levelup>
499.translation_tr: <levelup>	Yasasin, guzel gidiyor, peki ben ne zaman?	</levelup>

500.source_en: <levelup>	*berp*... sorry still have gas from last meal...did you just level?	</levelup>
500.translation_tr: <levelup>	*gegirir*... uzgunum, son yemekten hala gazim var... az once level mi atladin?	</levelup>

501.source_en: <levelup>	Let's have a good ol'hip hip hurrah, shall we?	</levelup>
501.translation_tr: <levelup>	Guzel bir hip hip hurra yapalim mi?	</levelup>

502.source_en: <levelup>	Hey, are we within sharing range yet, I really would like to start leeching.	</levelup>
502.translation_tr: <levelup>	Hey, sharing menziline girdik mi, gercekten leech yapmaya baslamak istiyorum.	</levelup>

505.source_en: <feeding>	I think I'm going to puke...	</feeding>

506.source_en: <feeding>	Please... no more nice surprises... I don't think my little tummy can take anymore.	</feeding>
506.translation_tr: <feeding>	Lutfen... daha fazla guzel surpriz olmasin... kucuk midem daha fazlasini kaldiramaz.	</feeding>

507.source_en: <feeding>	No more please... oh the pain... THE PAIN.....*burp*... don't think I can eat much more.	</feeding>
507.translation_tr: <feeding>	Daha fazla olmasin lutfen... ah aci... ACI.....*gegirir*... daha fazla yiyebilecegimi sanmiyorum.	</feeding>

508.source_en: <feeding>	That's it, I'm calling cruelty to animals, this is gorging!!	</feeding>
508.translation_tr: <feeding>	Bu kadar, hayvanlara kotu muameleyi ariyorum, bu resmen tikindirma!!	</feeding>

509.source_en: <hunting>	I think I shall now be sick... *mphf*	</hunting>

510.source_en: <hunting>	Please slow down, I have such tiny and cute little legs... see? ^^	</hunting>
510.translation_tr: <hunting>	Lutfen yavasla, minicik ve tatli bacaklarim var... goruyor musun? ^^	</hunting>

511.source_en: <hunting>	Why can't you carry me in your bag or something?	</hunting>

512.source_en: <hunting>	Oh my, I AM getting fat!! Why didn't you tell me!	</hunting>

513.source_en: <hunting>	You're just using me as a fat bunny lure aren't you! AREN'T YOU!!	</hunting>
513.translation_tr: <hunting>	Beni sadece sisman tavsan yemi olarak kullaniyorsun, degil mi! DEGIL MI!!	</hunting>

514.source_en: <danger>	Blood... ewww... ugh... uh... oh... BLARRRRRRRRRRRRRGH... EWWWWW!	</danger>
514.translation_tr: <danger>	Kan... iyy... ugh... ah... oh... BLARRRRRRRRRRRRRGH... IYYYYY!	</danger>

515.source_en: <danger>	LUNATIC POWER!... ... ... hmm, never mind, it's all yours.	</danger>
515.translation_tr: <danger>	LUNATIC GUCU!... ... ... hmm, bos ver, hepsi senin.	</danger>

516.source_en: <danger>	Um, maybe you shouldn't have given me that last carrot, you look like you could use it.	</danger>
516.translation_tr: <danger>	Ee, belki son havucu bana vermemeliydin, senin ihtiyacin var gibi.	</danger>

517.source_en: <danger>	FEEL THE BURN... or.. is that just straight pain?	</danger>
517.translation_tr: <danger>	YANMAYI HISSET... yoksa... bu sadece dogrudan aci mi?	</danger>

518.source_en: <danger>	If you hadn't had fed me that last carrot, you'd be able to heal yourself right now, but I love you anyways.	</danger>
518.translation_tr: <danger>	Son havucu bana vermeseydin simdi kendini iyilestirebilirdin ama seni yine de seviyorum.	</danger>

520.source_en: <dead>	Hey, did you hear the latest news about... oh, when did you die?!? Dang it...	</dead>
520.translation_tr: <dead>	Hey, son haberi duydun mu... ah, ne zaman oldun?!? Kahretsin...	</dead>

522.source_en: <stand>	I'm not fat I'm big boned!... with lots of poofy... fur... right?	</stand>
522.translation_tr: <stand>	Sisman degilim, iri kemikliyim!... ve cok kabarik... tuyum var... degil mi?	</stand>

523.source_en: <stand>	Here is a cup of tea for you, and one for you... and one for you.... WHAT DO YOU MEAN IT'S EMPTY!!	</stand>
523.translation_tr: <stand>	Sana bir fincan cay, sana da... sana da.... BOS NE DEMEK!!	</stand>

524.source_en: <stand>	Pick me up, take me with you, please don't make me walk around, I'm so tired.	</stand>
524.translation_tr: <stand>	Beni kaldir, yaninda gotur, lutfen yurutme, cok yorgunum.	</stand>

525.source_en: <connect>	I can't move...my little legs can't move, OH NO, WHAT'S BECOME OF ME!!	</connect>
525.translation_tr: <connect>	Hareket edemiyorum... kucuk bacaklarim hareket etmiyor, AH HAYIR, BANA NE OLDU!!	</connect>

526.source_en: <connect>	So the other day I met this hot looking Lunatic and told me I was chubby! Do you think I'm chubby?	</connect>
526.translation_tr: <connect>	Gecen gun cok cekici bir Lunatic ile tanistim, bana tombul dedi! Sence tombul muyum?	</connect>

527.source_en: <connect>	Finally! You haven't been making other accounts have you? Playing other characters?? YOU PROMISED!!	</connect>
527.translation_tr: <connect>	Sonunda! Baska hesaplar acmadin degil mi? Baska karakterlerle oynamadin?? SOZ VERMISTIN!!	</connect>

528.source_en: <connect>	Hi... um... Can you give me my exercise machine back now?	</connect>
528.translation_tr: <connect>	Selam... ee... egzersiz makinemi geri verir misin?	</connect>

529.source_en: <connect>	Master!!! I made some tea for you... isn't it great?... what do you mean it's cold, you're the one who left.	</connect>
529.translation_tr: <connect>	Efendim!!! Sana cay yaptim... harika degil mi?... soguk ne demek, giden sendin.	</connect>

530.source_en: <connect>	You know, I was just thinking, the world would be a better place if people would STOP STEPPING ON ME!!	</connect>
530.translation_tr: <connect>	Dusunuyordum da, insanlar USTUME BASMAYI BIRAKSA dunya daha iyi bir yer olurdu!!	</connect>

531.source_en: <levelup>	...I really... need... to... use the... potty...	</levelup>

532.source_en: <levelup>	I prepared this little poem for you... shoot, where did it go...	</levelup>
532.translation_tr: <levelup>	Senin icin kucuk bir siir hazirladim... kahretsin, nereye gitti...	</levelup>

533.source_en: <levelup>	Congratulations! Now we can go and do some sit-ups and work on those abs!	</levelup>
533.translation_tr: <levelup>	Tebrikler! Simdi mekik cekip karin kaslarina calisabiliriz!	</levelup>

534.source_en: <levelup>	Hey, look at that you're catching up to my level...	</levelup>

539.source_en: <feeding>	*Tweet* Thank you! But my little birdie tummy isn't full just yet!	</feeding>
539.translation_tr: <feeding>	*Cik cik* Tesekkurler! Ama kucuk kus midem daha doymadi!	</feeding>

540.source_en: <feeding>	Finally! If you took any longer I thought I'd get smaller from not eating.	</feeding>
540.translation_tr: <feeding>	Sonunda! Biraz daha gec kalsan yememekten kuculecegimi sandim.	</feeding>

541.source_en: <feeding>	Could you bring me more food?	</feeding>
541.translation_tr: <feeding>	Bana daha fazla yemek getirir misin?	</feeding>

542.source_en: <feeding>	I never take food from strangers... but I've seen you around a bit, gimme more please!	</feeding>
542.translation_tr: <feeding>	Yabancilardan asla yemek almam... ama seni bir suredir goruyorum, biraz daha ver lutfen!	</feeding>

543.source_en: <hunting>	Hey you know, thief bugs sound MIGHTY scrumptious right about now!	</hunting>
543.translation_tr: <hunting>	Hey, su anda Thief Buglar COK lezzetli geliyor!	</hunting>

544.source_en: <hunting>	If that thing comes near me I'll peck it's eyes out... mmm... eyeballs.	</hunting>
544.translation_tr: <hunting>	O sey bana yaklasirsa gozlerini oyacagim... mmm... gozler.	</hunting>

545.source_en: <danger>	Yo, your like...dying and stuff....feed me before that happens.	</danger>
545.translation_tr: <danger>	Hey, sen sanki... oluyorsun falan... olmadan once beni besle.	</danger>

546.source_en: <danger>	Hey everyone, come watch. Someone's going to die soon!	</danger>
546.translation_tr: <danger>	Hey herkes, gelin bakin. Birisi birazdan olecek!	</danger>

547.source_en: <dead>	NOOOO, now I will starve to death... SOMEONE FEED ME!	</dead>
547.translation_tr: <dead>	HAYIIIR, simdi acliktan olecegim... BIRISI BENI BESLESIN!	</dead>

548.source_en: <dead>	I should look for somebody who will feed me..	</dead>

551.source_en: <connect>	Hey guy, welcome back...yada yada yada...where's the food?	</connect>
551.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey dostum, hos geldin... bla bla bla... yemek nerede?	</connect>

553.source_en: <levelup>	Good job! We should celebrate with a huge dinner...me first!	</levelup>
553.translation_tr: <levelup>	Iyi is! Buyuk bir yemekle kutlamaliyiz... once ben!	</levelup>

554.source_en: <levelup>	There should be a stat point for "FEED PET"!	</levelup>
554.translation_tr: <levelup>	"PET BESLE" icin bir stat puani olmali!	</levelup>

555.source_en: <levelup>	Hey, does that mean I get a treat?	</levelup>
555.translation_tr: <levelup>	Hey, bu bana odul yiyecegi var demek mi?	</levelup>

559.source_en: <feeding>	La la la laa Laa la la laaaa :))	</feeding>
559.translation_tr: <feeding>	La la la laa Laa la la laaaa :))	</feeding>

560.source_en: <hunting>	Look a nice scrumptious WORM! Get it get it get it!	</hunting>
560.translation_tr: <hunting>	Bak, nefis bir SOLUCAN! Al onu, al, al!	</hunting>

562.source_en: <danger>	Noo... your going to die soon! Who is going to feed me!?	</danger>
562.translation_tr: <danger>	Hayir... yakinda oleceksin! Beni kim besleyecek!?	</danger>

563.source_en: <danger>	Let me see if I can find you anything to heal yourself with, you need it.	</danger>
563.translation_tr: <danger>	Seni iyilestirecek bir sey bulabilir miyim bakayim, ihtiyacin var.	</danger>

564.source_en: <dead>	I always wanted to try being a bird of prey, mind if I take a snip of your flesh?	</dead>
564.translation_tr: <dead>	Hep yirtici kus olmayi denemek istemisimdir, etinden biraz gagalasin mi?	</dead>

565.source_en: <dead>	I'm so hungry... hmm, you don't seem to be moving, mind if I take a nibble?	</dead>
565.translation_tr: <dead>	Cok acim... hmm, hareket etmiyorsun, biraz kemirsem olur mu?	</dead>

566.source_en: <stand>	I'm a bit hungry, do you have anything might be able to snack on?	</stand>
566.translation_tr: <stand>	Biraz acim, atistirabilecegim bir sey var mi?	</stand>

567.source_en: <stand>	I'm starting to get hungry, mind if we snack?	</stand>
567.translation_tr: <stand>	Acikmaya basladim, biraz atistirsak olur mu?	</stand>

568.source_en: <connect>	Hey there! How's life?.. never mind.. what's for lunch?	</connect>
568.translation_tr: <connect>	Selam! Hayat nasil?.. bos ver.. oglen ne yiyoruz?	</connect>

569.source_en: <connect>	You were in my dreams... I dreamt that you fed me a nice little snack.	</connect>
569.translation_tr: <connect>	Ruyamdaydin... bana guzel bir atistirmalik verdigini gordum.	</connect>

570.source_en: <levelup>	*Tweet* Ce~le~brate good times come on!...so lets eat!	</levelup>
570.translation_tr: <levelup>	*Cik cik* Ku~tla~ guzel zamanlari!... hadi yiyelim!	</levelup>

571.source_en: <levelup>	Good for you! When do we eat?	</levelup>
571.translation_tr: <levelup>	Senin adina sevindim! Ne zaman yiyoruz?	</levelup>

575.source_en: <feeding>	I'm not all that hungry, but if you insist... we can't have food going to waste now, can we?	</feeding>
575.translation_tr: <feeding>	O kadar ac degilim ama israr ediyorsan... yemegi ziyan edemeyiz, degil mi?	</feeding>

576.source_en: <hunting>	Go master, go master, unh unh, go master...	</hunting>
576.translation_tr: <hunting>	Hadi efendim, hadi efendim, unh unh, hadi...	</hunting>

577.source_en: <hunting>	Fear the wrath of the claw! Nothing can stop, the claw!!	</hunting>
577.translation_tr: <hunting>	Pencenin gazabindan kork! Hicbir sey durduramaz, PENCEYI!!	</hunting>

578.source_en: <danger>	I'll be okay master, please use the red herb to keep yourself alive!	</danger>
578.translation_tr: <danger>	Ben iyiyim efendim, lutfen hayatta kalmak icin Red Herb kullan!	</danger>

579.source_en: <danger>	Don't worry, when you're dead I'll avenge you when I become a Peco Peco!	</danger>
579.translation_tr: <danger>	Endiselenme, oldugunde Peco Peco olunca intikamini alacagim!	</danger>

580.source_en: <dead>	You die faster then I do.	</dead>

581.source_en: <dead>	You need more training little one...	</dead>
581.translation_tr: <dead>	Daha cok egitime ihtiyacin var ufaklik...	</dead>

582.source_en: <stand>	I remember the first day you fed me that worm...	</stand>
582.translation_tr: <stand>	Beni o solucanla ilk besledigin gunu hatirliyorum...	</stand>

583.source_en: <stand>	What else are we gonna do today?	</stand>

584.source_en: <connect>	*Tweets* I'm singing in the rain...oh, you're back I was just practicing for my new part in a play.	</connect>
584.translation_tr: <connect>	*Cik cik* Yagmurda sarki soyluyorum... ah, geri geldin, oyundaki yeni rolume calisiyordum.	</connect>

585.source_en: <connect>	Hey, you're back! I've been practicing my claw attacks! Let's go test'em!	</connect>
585.translation_tr: <connect>	Hey, geri geldin! Pence saldirilarima calisiyordum! Hadi deneyelim!	</connect>

587.source_en: <levelup>	I will name my next hatched egg in honor of you.	</levelup>
587.translation_tr: <levelup>	Siradaki yumurtadan cikan yavruya senin adini verecegim.	</levelup>

590.source_en: <feeding>	*tweet*BURP* Oh I'm so full! Please no more...	</feeding>
590.translation_tr: <feeding>	*cik cik*GEGIRIR* Ah cok tokum! Lutfen daha fazla verme...	</feeding>

591.source_en: <feeding>	If I eat anything else, I think I'll explode!	</feeding>
591.translation_tr: <feeding>	Bir sey daha yersem patlayacagim sanirim!	</feeding>

592.source_en: <feeding>	I think that last one made me sick, I don't feel too good.	</feeding>
592.translation_tr: <feeding>	Sanirim sonuncusu beni hasta etti, pek iyi hissetmiyorum.	</feeding>

593.source_en: <hunting>	Hey, sit down and rest for a bit. I can't keep up with how fast you're killin'! Darn my little wings.	</hunting>
593.translation_tr: <hunting>	Hey, otur ve biraz dinlen. Bu oldurme hizina yetisemiyorum! Su kucuk kanatlarim...	</hunting>

594.source_en: <hunting>	When I become a Peco Peco, I'll let you ride me so you don't get tired.	</hunting>
594.translation_tr: <hunting>	Peco Peco olunca yorulmaman icin seni sirtimda tasiyacagim.	</hunting>

595.source_en: <danger>	I shall use my wing of healing for you...as soon as I learn it...until then...ANY ONE GOT A RED POTION?	</danger>
595.translation_tr: <danger>	Senin icin iyilestirme kanadimi kullanacagim... ogrenir ogrenmez... o zamana kadar... KIRMIZI IKSIRI OLAN VAR MI?	</danger>

596.source_en: <danger>	Please don't die, I don't know what I would do if I lost you.	</danger>
596.translation_tr: <danger>	Lutfen olme, seni kaybedersem ne yaparim bilmiyorum.	</danger>
